title: Join Words
statement: Implement `solve(words, sep)`. Strip each word, drop empties, and join the rest with `sep`. Do not put the separator before the first word or after the last.
hints: str.join inserts the separator between items only.
No surviving words returns an empty string.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: join is the linear way to build this string.

editorial: join is the linear way to build this string. Concatenating in a loop copies a growing buffer. Filtering blanks first keeps the separator from doubling up around empty slots.
